_meta.title: GridWise — Extended Synthetic Hidden-Like Regression Pack
_meta.generated_for: BUP CSE Fest 2026 GridWise LLM challenge
_meta.important_notice: These are synthetic hidden-like and edge-focused cases created from the published contract and public examples. They are NOT leaked or official hidden judge cases.

compatibility.core_case_shape: same input/expected_output structure as the public sample pack

research_basis: Organizer public sample pack and canonical problem statement
OpenAI Structured Outputs guidance: use schema-constrained outputs and evaluations
Gemini structured output guidance: validate semantic values even when JSON is schema-valid
OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet: treat untrusted text as data, validate outputs
Metamorphic-testing research: test semantic invariance under equivalent paraphrases
how_to_use: Replay the returned hourly_plan against the official constraints.
Do not require byte-for-byte equality with the provided hourly_plan; equivalent optimal schedules are valid.
Use optimization_reference.lp_relaxation_cost_bdt as a lower-bound diagnostic and milp_optimal_cost_bdt as the synthetic reference optimum.
Do not hard-code these synthetic phrases; mutate them further.
